I'll go with 232.30.46.21.01.002 with moderate-low confidence given the AI-generated appearance.

Hmm, but the case size — hard to tell. Let me just pick 42mm? The date window and layout look 45.5mm with 3 and 9 numerals? Actually the photo shows numerals at 6, 9, 12 and bars elsewhere, date at 3.
